header.title: Expenses
header.subtitle: History, filters, and quick edits to your movements.

emptyState.introTitle: You haven't logged any expenses yet
emptyState.introBody: Here you'll see every household movement: how much you've spent this cycle, your daily allowance, and the day-by-day detail. Add your first one to get started.

preview.heroDescription: How much you've spent and your daily allowance available.
preview.calendarDescription: A calendar with your spending days this month.
preview.listDescription: The detail by day, with category and author.

filterPill.hintApply: Double tap to filter by this category
filterPill.hintRemove: Double tap to remove the filter

calendar.hintInert: Each day will be colored based on your spending
calendar.hintTap: Tap a day to filter its expenses
calendar.registerForgottenA11y: Log a forgotten expense on this day
calendar.markNoSpendA11y: Mark this day as no spend
calendar.unmarkNoSpendA11y: Undo the no-spend mark for this day

noSpendConfirm.title: You already have expenses logged today
noSpendConfirm.subtitle: We're showing you what you logged today so you can double-check before marking the day as no spend.
noSpendConfirm.tip: If you slip up, you can undo the mark by tapping "Marked ✓" on the same FAB button.

streakSheet.markNoSpendA11y: Mark the day as no spend
streakSheet.unmarkNoSpendA11y: Undo the no-spend mark for this day

markAlert.title: Mark day as no spend
markAlert.message: Confirm you didn't spend today? Your streak keeps going and you add a day to your progress. You can undo it if an expense shows up later.

unmarkAlert.title: Undo no spend day
unmarkAlert.message: An expense showed up and you want to undo today's mark? Your streak goes back to depending on logging before midnight.

shieldNotice.body: If you don't log today, the shield protects your streak automatically at 11:59 PM.

consequence.title: If you don't log today
consequence.regress: You go back to day {{day}} (start of {{level}})
consequence.lose_one: You lose {{count}} day of progress earned
consequence.lose_other: You lose {{count}} days of progress earned
consequence.needMore: You'd need {{days}} more days to reach {{nextLevel}}

motivational.nearRecord: You're {{away}} days from your personal record of {{record}} days.
motivational.atRecord: 🏆 You're at your personal record. Keep it up!

freezeInfo.line1: You earn a shield every 7 days of streak in a row.
freezeInfo.line2: You have {{tokens}} · You can stack up to 2.

shieldChip.hint_none: You earn one every 7 days of streak in a row.
shieldChip.hint_one: You have 1 left. It'll cover a day without logging.
shieldChip.hint_full: Stock full. Each one covers a missed day.

pendingConfirm.primary: Your expenses are waiting for the new month
pendingConfirm.secondary: You already logged movements for the next cycle. Confirm your payday so they show up here.

global.secondary: Start the cycle by logging one

filtered.secondary: Try removing a filter to see more

cycle.secondary: When you log one, you'll see it here

noSpend.expensesExist: That day has expenses logged — it can't be marked as no spend.
noSpend.futureDate: You can't mark a day that hasn't happened yet.
noSpend.markFailed: Couldn't mark it. Try again in a moment.
noSpend.unmarkFailed: Couldn't undo it. Try again in a moment.

errors.snapshotEmpty: The expenses snapshot came back empty.

errors.amountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.noFamilyCreate: No active household to create a category.

ateTomorrow.title: You've already eaten into tomorrow
ateTomorrow.detail: If you stop now, tomorrow you'd open with {{amount}}.

zeroDay.title: Zero-spend day active
zeroDay.detail: If you close the day like this, tomorrow you start with {{amount}}.

operatingMargin.title: There's still operating room
operatingMargin.detail: You still have {{amount}} left for the rest of the day.

carryover.titleNegative: The carryover is squeezing you today
carryover.detailPositive: You're carrying {{amount}} of room built up below your pace.
carryover.detailNegative: You're carrying {{amount}} of overspend from previous days.

buffer.titleIntact: Your cushion is still defending the close
buffer.titleConsumed: The cushion is no longer covering swings
buffer.detailIntact: {{amount}} of the cushion is still intact to absorb swings.
buffer.detailConsumed: The cushion is used up. From here you start touching the main plan.

overspendRisk.title: Risk of overspending before your next payday
overspendRisk.detail: If the current pace continues, you'd be short {{missing}}. Cut about {{perDay}} per day to land with room.

adjustPace.title: You need to adjust your daily pace
adjustPace.detail: To reach your next payday without falling short, try cutting around {{amount}} per day from tomorrow.

concentration.title: Spending is heavily concentrated
concentration.detail: {{category}} makes up {{percent}}% of the month. It's the best category to look for cuts without touching the whole budget.

recurring.title: There's a repeated expense to audit
recurring.detail: "{{label}}" showed up {{count}} times in 60 days and adds up to {{total}}. Worth checking whether it's a subscription, fee, or recurring habit.

weekend.title: Weekends are pushing the total up
weekend.detail: Weekend daily spending is running {{percent}}% above the Monday-to-Friday average.

weeklyAccel.title: Spending accelerated this week
weeklyAccel.detail: The last 7 days rose {{percent}}% versus the previous week. Check what sped up before it sets in.

healthy.title: Your pace is healthy
healthy.detail: At the current pattern you'd close the cycle with {{amount}} available.

noAlerts.title: No strong alerts yet
noAlerts.detail: No strong alerts yet, but it's worth keeping an eye on the month's close.

headline.healthy: If you keep this up, there should still be room at the end of the month.
headline.short: If you keep this up, the month ends short and it's worth correcting now.

cutPerDay.label: Cut per day
cutPerDay.helper: Suggested cut to reach your next payday.

weeklyPace.label: Weekly pace
weeklyPace.helperNoBase: Not enough basis yet to compare weeks.
weeklyPace.helperLighter: This week is running lighter or steady.

last7.label: Last 7 days
last7.helper: Variable spending accumulated over the last 7 days.

weekend.label: Weekend
weekend.helper: Compares Saturdays and Sundays against the Monday-to-Friday average.

warning.noMerchant: No description. Fill it in before confirming.
warning.noDate: No clear date. We assumed today.
